decisions.decision: charge_sessions carries identity + window + the 5 pct columns + site_location_name/energy_kwh/total_cost/currency/is_paid, using telemetry's names. Excludes country_code, unlatch_date_time, billing_type, vehicle_make_type, raw_data.
decisions.why: Owner amended this AT the gate from a sidecar to a real mirror, so charging answers 'how was this charged' without reaching into telemetry. Telemetry names keep the backfill a literal copy.

decisions.decision: Dense - one row per Supercharger session, poller-written; pct columns start NULL.
decisions.why: A date-range read over charge_sessions alone returns every session with its window and any verified pct, no join into telemetry. Matches the read-heavy profile.

decisions.decision: Carry both vin (durable, write-once) and tesla_id (refreshed each sync). UNIQUE (account_id, session_id); INDEX (account_id, tesla_id, charge_stop_date_time) ASC.
decisions.why: tesla_id drifts (telemetry re-resolves it, NULL when unregistered) but reads filter on it. Index leads to stop-time because D12: energy lands at stop, which is what end_battery_pct describes.

decisions.decision: EXPAND ONLY. T6 ships the charging-dir migration alone and drops NOTHING from telemetry; the contract half is a later change.
decisions.why: MIGRATIONS_DIRS runs telemetry before charging dir-by-dir, so a same-change DROP executes before the backfill and destroys data that cannot be recomputed - nothing writes those columns, so the one populated row was hand-entered.

decisions.decision: CHECK: pct set => battery_pct_source NOT NULL. Backfill resolves the one legacy row via COALESCE(battery_pct_source,'user_verified').
decisions.why: No code path can write those columns, so a present percentage is by construction human-entered - inference from write-protection, not invention.

decisions.decision: Ship no SessionReader in this tier; do NOT file the total_cost DOUBLE PRECISION float-for-money divergence as a backlog item.
decisions.why: Reader with no caller is speculative surface (tier 5 precedent). Money type is recorded in design.md; owner judged that sufficient.

decisions.decision: Probed the to_regclass-guarded DO block against sqlc before the gate rather than leaving it asserted; dropped the EXECUTE fallback.
decisions.why: It was the design's biggest unproven assumption. make sqlc exit 0, correct ChargeSession model, no supercharger_sessions leak. Tree reverted after.
